aarti.do1: Śāradā, enthroned throughout the world, has boundless glory. Mother, you took incarnation for the good of your devotees.
aarti.tek: Mother Śāradā, at your court I sing the āratī every day; every day I sing it, Mother, every day.
aarti.pad1: I offer a lamp of faith, a wick of love and the oil of my tears. May I have the sight of you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: I offer a garland of my mind, the pearls of my eyes (my tears) and the flowers of my feelings. May I have the sight of you. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: I offer my strength as food, and my every breath day and night, and with (bowed) shoulders I tell you my prayer. May I have the sight of you. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: I offer a garland of austerity, a ṭīkā of the listening ear and a banner of meditation. May I have the sight of you. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Every day I recite the Mother's hymns and āratī to holy men and saints. May I have the sight of you. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Remembering her again and again, singing the Mother's glory, I bow my head at her feet. May I have the sight of you. ॥6॥
